trustedValidationBoundary.actualPredicate: review.iterations must be an integer from1through3 and review.status must equal ACCEPTED; otherwise REVIEW_UNRESOLVED.
trustedValidationBoundary.derivedConditional: If a future SC-02 trusted review is submitted with iterations4, this predicate rejects it. This conditional is exact code analysis, not an observed SC-02 validation result.
trustedValidationBoundary.semanticLimitation: The helper consumes supplied review.iterations and does not derive it from commit counts, browser attempts, asset ordinals or local report field actualProductCorrectionCycle. The workflow describes capped repair/re-review iterations but does not explicitly map all historical mixed-scope review transitions into a future final per-contract field.
trustedValidationBoundary.supportedHistory: The cumulative count4 label remains preserved. No prospective iterations1,2or3 is selected by this audit, and no owner exception or counter reset is invented. Eligibility under a different proposed scope remains an unresolved interpretation until recorded through the existing authority; no protected dispatch follows from this audit.

correctionToEarlierInterpretation.correction: Earlier reports equated the historical actualProductCorrectionCycle4 label with an actual trusted review.iterations4 and presented PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_REVIEW_UNRESOLVED:spatial-pilot.experience as an exact current gate. No SC-02 trusted review is assembled, so that was a prospective rejection under an assumed mapping, not an emitted validation result. The audit qualifies that interpretation only; all raw history, cumulative transitions and rendered decisions remain unchanged.
correctionToEarlierInterpretation.localDispositionClarification: The current local helper result is VERIFY_FINAL_EVIDENCE, even when the historical iteration label4 is supplied. A global BLOCK_WITH_EVIDENCE statement may retain independently supported unfulfilled obligations, but must not be attributed to the local no-blocker helper result.
correctionToEarlierInterpretation.noAutomaticAcceptance: No trusted ACCEPTED review, eligible final iterations value, protected qualification, native/physical readiness or owner acceptance is granted.

The source-bound history supports four cumulative re-review transitions, but mixed asset/product/evidence scope prevents claiming an already assembled final trusted field solely from that label.

Missing Crossdeck experience design remains independently observed in the valid read-only exact-base planner. Full selected Player/shared-consumer evidence and unsigned local-capture/native/audio/owner boundaries remain unchanged.
